_comment: Canonical research-area vocabulary taken only from labels already used on professor records. Do not invent areas. Related labels are listed separately on purpose (e.g. Medical AI vs Healthcare AI vs Biomedical AI; Foundation Models vs Large Language Models; Multimodal AI vs Multimodal Learning). Computer Science is retained because it appears on professor records; it is too generic for matching and is flagged for a later taxonomy pass. source_url is omitted unless a catalog-level official definition URL exists.

research_areas.name: Machine Learning
research_areas.description: Algorithms and theory for learning patterns from data, including supervised, unsupervised, and statistical learning.

research_areas.name: Artificial Intelligence
research_areas.description: Broad intelligent-systems research spanning reasoning, learning, perception, and decision-making when a more specific label was not used.

research_areas.name: Computer Vision
research_areas.description: Machine interpretation of images and video, including recognition, reconstruction, and visual understanding.

research_areas.name: Natural Language Processing
research_areas.description: Computational processing and understanding of human language, including text analysis, generation, and linguistics-informed models.

research_areas.name: Robotics
research_areas.description: Embodied systems for perception, planning, control, and physical interaction with the world.

research_areas.name: Deep Learning
research_areas.description: Neural-network methods, architectures, and training for representation learning and prediction.

research_areas.name: Trustworthy AI
research_areas.description: Reliability, robustness, privacy, security, fairness, and related properties of AI systems.

research_areas.name: Medical AI
research_areas.description: AI methods applied to medical imaging, clinical diagnosis, and medicine-centered modeling. Kept distinct from Healthcare AI and Biomedical AI.

research_areas.name: AI for Science
research_areas.description: Machine learning and AI used to accelerate scientific discovery in the natural and physical sciences.

research_areas.name: Efficient AI
research_areas.description: Reducing compute, memory, energy, or data cost of training and deploying AI models.

research_areas.name: Data Science
research_areas.description: Large-scale data analysis, mining, and statistical methods that overlap with but are not limited to core ML.

research_areas.name: Large Language Models
research_areas.description: Large-scale language models and their training, adaptation, evaluation, and use. Kept distinct from Foundation Models.

research_areas.name: Reinforcement Learning
research_areas.description: Learning sequential decision policies from interaction, reward, or demonstration.

research_areas.name: Foundation Models
research_areas.description: General-purpose pretrained models across modalities or tasks, not limited to language. Kept distinct from Large Language Models.

research_areas.name: Multimodal Learning
research_areas.description: Learning from combined modalities such as vision and language. Kept distinct from Multimodal AI.

research_areas.name: AI Agents
research_areas.description: Autonomous or semi-autonomous agents that plan, act, and interact over time. No Agentic AI label exists in the current professor files.

research_areas.name: AI Systems
research_areas.description: Systems, infrastructure, and runtime support for training and serving AI workloads.

research_areas.name: Human-Centered AI
research_areas.description: AI designed around human interaction, collaboration, HCI, and human-AI teaming.

research_areas.name: Computer Science
research_areas.description: Generic departmental label present on some professor records. Too broad for research matching; retain mappings and review later. Do not treat as an AI topic.

research_areas.name: Healthcare AI
research_areas.description: AI for health-system delivery, clinical operations, and patient-care workflows. Kept distinct from Medical AI and Biomedical AI.

research_areas.name: Biomedical AI
research_areas.description: AI for biological and biomedical science, including genomics and molecular systems. Kept distinct from Medical AI and Healthcare AI.

research_areas.name: Computational Biology
research_areas.description: Computational methods for biological data and systems, including genomics and biomolecular modeling.

research_areas.name: Information Retrieval
research_areas.description: Search, ranking, and retrieval of documents or other items from large collections.

research_areas.name: Responsible AI
research_areas.description: Ethics, governance, accountability, and societal responsibility of AI systems. Related to but not merged with Trustworthy AI.

research_areas.name: Generative AI
research_areas.description: Models that generate text, images, or other media. Kept distinct from Foundation Models and Large Language Models.

research_areas.name: Multimodal AI
research_areas.description: AI systems that jointly handle multiple modalities. Kept distinct from Multimodal Learning.

research_areas.name: Edge AI
research_areas.description: AI models and inference on resource-constrained or on-device platforms.

research_areas.name: Explainable AI
research_areas.description: Methods that make model predictions interpretable or attributable to humans.

research_areas.name: Recommender Systems
research_areas.description: Personalized ranking and recommendation of items to users.

research_areas.name: AI Media Synthesis
research_areas.description: Synthesis of media content with AI; rare label retained as used on professor records.

research_areas.name: Embodied AI
research_areas.description: Learning and intelligence in physically or virtually embodied agents. Related to Robotics; kept separate.

research_areas.name: Multi-Agent Systems
research_areas.description: Interaction among multiple agents. Related to AI Agents; kept separate.

research_areas.name: Object Recognition
research_areas.description: Visual recognition of objects. Subsumable under Computer Vision in a later pass; retained as used.

research_areas.name: Spatial AI
research_areas.description: AI for spatial understanding, mapping, or spatially grounded perception.

research_areas.name: Speech / Language AI
research_areas.description: Speech and spoken-language AI. Possible future fold into Natural Language Processing; retained as used.
